title: HEART: Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer for ECG Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning robust representations from electrocardiograms (ECGs) is challenging because repeated cardiac cycles coexist with subtle and sparse diagnostic cues in local morphology and rhythm-level context. Existing ECG foundation models commonly rely on Transformerbased patch encoders with uniformly shared dense refinement pathways, limiting adaptive processing across heterogeneous ECG tokens. We propose HEART (Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer), an ECG foundation model that introduces stage-specific conditional expert refinement during self-supervised pre-training. HEART places a local-level MoE over patch-level representations before temporal contextualization and a global-level MoE over context-integrated token representations after self-attention. translated_abstract: 从心电图（ECG）中学习稳健的表示具有挑战性，因为重复出现的心动周期与局部形态和节律级上下文中微妙且稀疏的诊断线索共存。现有的ECG基础模型通常依赖基于Transformer的补丁编码器，并采用统一共享的密集细化路径，限制了对异构ECG标记的自适应处理能力。我们提出了HEART（层次化专家自适应细化Transformer），这是一种在自监督预训练中引入阶段特异性条件专家细化的ECG基础模型。HEART在时间上下文化之前，对补丁级表示设置局部级混合专家（MoE）；在自注意力之后，对上下文整合后的标记表示设置全局级MoE。标记级Top-1路由允许同一ECG内的不同补丁或上下文标记遵循不同的专家路径。在公开的ECG基准上，HEART取得了（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出HEART——一种在自监督预训练中于局部和全局两个层级引入条件混合专家（MoE）细化机制、并通过标记级Top-1路由实现对异构ECG标记自适应处理的心电图基础模型。
en_tdlr: HEART is an ECG foundation model that introduces stage-specific local-level and global-level Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) refinement with token-level Top-1 routing during self-supervised pre-training, enabling adaptive processing of heterogeneous ECG tokens.
